properties.site-address: Quayside part of Blackfriars LDO, Quay Street, Westgate
properties.notes: student accomodation is currently being constructed on the barbican part of the site and it is likely that the quayside portion 1.7 ha could accommodate a significant number of dwellings at high density if proposed. Flood risk is significant on parts of the site. A residential led Local Development Order for predominantly residential uses with other supporting uses
